title: See Niagara Falls in winter

location.label: Niagara Falls State Park, New York

description: Walk the paths at Niagara Falls State Park when cold air coats railings and nearby trees with spray-born ice. The water still moves powerfully, while the surrounding landscape takes on a quieter winter shape. Dress warmly, choose open viewpoints, and watch how the light and mist change the scene from one stop to the next.
teaser: Watch winter reshape the edges of Niagara Falls.
goodToKnow: The falls do not freeze solid. Check the trolley schedule, weather and icy footing on the day you visit.
whyItMightDelightYou: The contrast of moving water and frozen spray makes a familiar landmark feel new.
